text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... I didn't think the line for the 
visitor giveaway would be this long... At 
this rate, I won't make it in time for the 
paddock...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Ngggh, desperate times call for desperate 
measures...! Let's head to the paddock 
first...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only did Chrono Genesis miss the 
paddock, she also had to line up again in 
the massive queue for the visitor giveaway 
gifts...
